property_summary: initialize() on a fresh pool sets initialized to true and stores exactly the given parameters, and any second initialize() call reverts with AlreadyInitialized.
When the merkle root is unset (bytes32(0)), sumWeightsAndValidateProof must return tokenIds.length * 1e18 regardless of the supplied weights and proof.

On an uninitialized pool (base token = address(0)), changeFeeQuote(inputAmount) must return feeAmount == inputAmount * changeFee / 10000 and a protocol fee equal to feeAmount * protocolFeeRate / 10000 for any input amount.
On a freshly deployed pool that owns no NFTs, availableForFlashLoan must return false for every token address and token id (never reverting).
On a fresh, uninitialized pool (virtualNftReserves == 0), price() must always revert due to division by zero, and never return a value.

property_summary: On a fresh pool, initialize() succeeds exactly when feeRate <= 5000, setting initialized() to true; any initialize() with feeRate > 5000 reverts and leaves initialized() false.
On a fresh (uninitialized) pool with zero merkle root, sumWeightsAndValidateProof never reverts and always returns tokenIds.length * 1e18, regardless of the supplied weights.
For any token and tokenId, flashFee always returns the pool's current changeFee value, i.e. flashFee(token, tokenId) == changeFee().
A call to setMerkleRoot from an address that is not the pool's owner (the holder of the pool's factory NFT) always reverts and leaves merkleRoot unchanged.

After initialization with any feeRate <= 5000, sellQuote never pays out less than half of the gross output amount: the returned netOutputAmount is at least outputAmount/2 where outputAmount = inputAmount * virtualBaseTokenReserves / (virtualNftReserves + inputAmount).
initialize() stores all parameters and sets initialized()=true only when feeRate<=5000; otherwise it reverts and leaves state untouched (initialized()=false).
While the pool's merkleRoot is zero, sumWeightsAndValidateProof is open-access: it returns exactly 1e18 * tokenIds.length for any token list, regardless of supplied weights or proof.

For an initialized pool with virtual reserves (vbr, vnr) and fee rate f, buyQuote(amount) returns fee = inputAmount*f/10000 and netInput = inputAmount + fee + inputAmount*protocolFeeRate/10000, where inputAmount = ceil(amount*vbr/(vnr-amount)).
